cc:Work.dc:title: FragPack, vLLM, and LMCache
cc:Work.dc:description: FragPack is nested in the vLLM GPU worker; native BF16 records become compressed closed blocks consumed by fused decode attention. The FragPack–LMCache adapter and external compressed-blob path are proposed. Vector shapes and editable SVG text; Liberation Serif font.
